'''Groth''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="LoNH" /> located in the [[Groth system/Legends|Groth system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlanes]] linked it to the [[Kor Desilijic system/Legends|Kor Desilijic]], [[Kor Gejalli system/Legends|Kor Gejalli]], and [[Saki system/Legends|Saki system]]. At one point, Groth served as a [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of one of the [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], but eventually it became a resort<ref name="TEA" /> where Hutts spent their [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and watching [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights.<ref name="LoNH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Slice the Slicer" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> 
an [[Unidentified information broker|information broker]] who was based on Groth and employed multiple security traps [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into a military database and stole classified data. Subsequently, an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to Groth to both wipe the data and confiscate the client list of the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]]. The companion went on to maneuver the slicer into one of his own traps and thereby captured both him and the list.<ref name="Slice the Slicer">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Slice the Slicer}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Groth was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" /> The world was mentioned in a Slicing Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission was initially only available to Sith Empire&ndash;aligned players, though both this restriction and the information about the mission's outcome are no longer part of the game.<ref name="Slice the Slicer" />
